名次仅在当前授权与筛选范围内计算；同分并列，未提供的字段不参与排名。: Ranks use the records you can access with the current filters. Tied values share a rank. Missing stats are unranked.
显示所选服务器与来源档期的原始统计；未提供的字段显示 —，真实零值保留为 0。: Raw stats for the selected server and source wipe. Missing values show —; observed zero values remain 0.
导出此查询的所选服务器、来源档期与分类数据；保留缺失字段及来源时间。: Export the selected server, source wipe and categorized stats from this query, retaining missing values and source timestamps.
PDF / 图片文件生成失败，请重新提交导出；若再次失败，请联系管理员。: The PDF or image could not be generated. Submit the export again; if it fails again, contact an administrator.
PDF / 图片生成超时，请稍后重新提交导出，或缩小导出范围。: PDF or image generation timed out. Try exporting again later, or narrow the export scope.
导出服务暂时不可用，请稍后重新提交。: The export service is temporarily unavailable. Submit the export again later.
导出服务正忙，请稍后手动重新提交。: The export service is busy. Submit the export again later.
导出内容过多，请缩小筛选或时间范围后重新生成。: There is too much content to export. Narrow the filters or time period and generate the file again.
生成的文件过大，请缩小导出范围后重新生成。: The generated file is too large. Narrow the export scope and generate it again.
PDF / 图片文件校验失败，请重新提交导出；若再次失败，请联系管理员。: The generated PDF or image could not be validated. Submit the export again; if it fails again, contact an administrator.
导出请求无效，请重新选择范围与格式后提交。: The export request is invalid. Select the scope and format again before submitting.
导出格式无效，请重新选择格式。: The export format is invalid. Select a format again.
PDF / 图片导出服务尚不可用，请联系管理员；也可改用 HTML、CSV 或: PDF and image exports are unavailable. Contact an administrator, or choose HTML, CSV or JSON.

当前显示全部授权成员，可按姓名或队伍筛选。: Showing all accessible members. Filter by name or squad.

本页 {count} 位成员尚无已采集指标。: {count} members on this page have no observed metrics.

档期的服务器或来源档期已变化，请刷新后重新采集。: The server or source wipe has changed. Refresh and collect stats again.
此档期尚未设置开始时间，请先在档期管理中补全。: This wipe has no start time. Set it in wipe management first.
